model.name: R19.39: A system RawBin User unit owns the DnD debug/log messages.
model.description: A dedicated system User scenario unit named 'RawBin' MUST exist as the ownerIor for all system-generated messages — specifically the DnD unknown-drop debug/log messages from R19.37. When the drop dispatcher encounters an unknown format and writes a Message unit to the room chat, that Message's ownerIor points to the RawBin system user (not to any human user). This distinguishes system-generated log messages from user-sent chat messages in the UI and in traceability.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "add a RawBin user that owns the debug messages from dnd"
model.crossRefNote: R19.37 (unknown drop → room chat log) writes the Message units. R19.38 (messages as scenario units with ownerIor) defines their shape. R19.39 defines WHO owns the system-generated ones: a dedicated RawBin User unit.
